summary: Backend-only testing of the new self-reflection Journal feature. 23 pytest cases covered /api/journal/prompt, /api/journal/entries (CRUD + no-_id leak + cross-user isolation + limit clamping), /api/mediation/reflection auto-snapshot + dedup via signature hash, /api/journal/weekly-recap (entry-count gate + Claude call + caching), and guest-user access. 22 passed, 1 xfailed (prompt-unauth mismatch — see below).

minor.issue: Test plan specified this endpoint should return 401 unauthenticated, but the route has no auth dependency and returns 200 to anonymous callers. Probably intentional (the prompt is static, non-user content), but the spec/implementation mismatch should be reconciled — either add `Depends(get_current_user)` or update the spec.

Spec asked for 400 on empty content. Implementation uses Pydantic min_length=1 which returns 422. The explicit `if not content: raise 400` line is unreachable because Pydantic validates first. Functionally correct (rejected), but the status code differs from the spec. Test accepts either 400 or 422.

action_items: Decide whether GET /api/journal/prompt should require auth. If yes, add Depends(get_current_user). If no, update the test plan/spec.
Optionally normalise the empty-content rejection to 400 by relaxing Pydantic (min_length=0) and keeping the manual check, OR update the spec to 422. Either is acceptable; just keep them aligned.
critical_code_review_comments: journal_routes.py:163 — `await db.journal_entries.insert_one(doc)` mutates `doc` by adding `_id`. The next line builds the response from the same dict via `JournalEntryOut.model_fields.keys()` which luckily excludes `_id`, so no leak in practice — but this is brittle. Prefer constructing the response from a fresh dict before insert, or use `JournalEntryOut.model_validate(doc)`.

journal_routes.py:240 maybe_snapshot_reflection — dedup compares the latest snapshot signature only. If the user reverts to an OLDER snapshot's exact content, a new snapshot will still be created. Probably fine (and arguably desired — restoring is a meaningful event), but worth a comment.

journal_routes.py:296 week_start = now - timedelta(days=7) — this is a rolling 7-day window, not the ISO-week aligned with `week_iso`. The cache key uses ISO week but the entries fetched span a 7-day rolling window. So on a Tuesday, entries from last Wednesday are included in 'this week's recap'. Likely intentional, but the comment 'delivered each Sunday' suggests aligning to ISO-week boundaries would be more accurate.
ai_service.generate_journal_weekly_recap — no try/except around _extract_json; if Claude returns malformed JSON the upstream try/except in /weekly-recap catches it. Good defensive layer.
Empty-content 400 check at journal_routes.py:143 is dead code — Pydantic min_length=1 rejects with 422 first.

success_rate.backend: 22/22 functional tests passed (96% incl. xfail), 100% of in-spec endpoints behave correctly aside from the two minor spec/impl mismatches above

test_credentials: Used dynamically-registered TEST_ users (TEST_journal_a_*, TEST_journal_b_*, TEST_recap_*) and POST /api/auth/guest for guest tests. parent1@test.com untouched.
seed_data_creation: Each test class registers its own throwaway TEST_-prefixed users and seeds 1-3 journal entries. No global seed required. Guest accounts auto-created via /api/auth/guest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Journal suite is /app/backend/tests/test_journal.py — reusable. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Weekly-recap test actually calls Claude (~3-5s) so total runtime ~11s. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing, recap_text will be null and that test path pytest.skips. Cross-user + guest isolation already covered.
verified_endpoints: GET /api/journal/prompt — currently PUBLIC (200 unauth). prompt_id/prompt_text/date shape correct. Deterministic per-day (same prompt across multiple calls).
POST /api/journal/entries — 201 with entry_id/kind=daily/prompt echo; empty=422; >5000 chars=422; unknown prompt_id ok with prompt_text=null.
GET /api/journal/entries — newest-first; total accurate; limit clamped 1..200; no _id/user_id/week_iso/signature leak.
DELETE /api/journal/entries/:id — own=204; nonexistent=404; other-user=404; cross-user data isolated.

PUT /api/mediation/reflection — creates reflection_snapshot when content non-empty; identical re-save deduped via sha256 signature; all-empty fields skip; only `private: true` skips; modified content creates new snapshot (+1).

GET /api/journal/weekly-recap — <2 entries returns null recap_text/[]themes/null generated_at; >=2 entries calls Claude and returns 2-4-sentence recap_text and 3-5 lowercase themes; second call same week is cached (identical recap_text + generated_at). Graceful degrade verified: endpoint never 500s.
Guest users (POST /api/auth/guest) can use full journal — no premium gating.
